package.description: Real-time infrastructure monitoring agent with per-second metrics and a built-in web dashboard.

en-US.description: Real-time infrastructure monitoring agent with per-second metrics and a built-in web dashboard.
en-US.longDescription: Netdata is an open-source, real-time infrastructure monitoring agent. It collects thousands of metrics per second from the local system with minimal configuration, stores them locally and visualizes them in a built-in web dashboard. On Windows it installs as a service and can optionally be connected to Netdata Cloud for centralized, multi-node monitoring.
en-US.name: Netdata
